reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: Really great moisturizer. Loved that it's vegan as well. Pleasant, very mild and subtle smell. Only giving fewer stars because it did not improve dark spots.
reviews.zh: 保濕霜真係好好用，仲要係純素呢一點都加分。氣味舒服，好溫和、好淡。之所以比少啲星，係因為對色斑冇咩改善。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: Feels very nice. I have sensitive skin, and this serum is very soothing on my skin rather than being harsh or stinging.
reviews.zh: 感覺很好。我屬於敏感肌，這支精華對皮膚很舒緩，不會刺激或刺痛。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: Absorbs very well into the skin and non irritating, I haven't tried this brand in a while and forgot how much I loved it! It does leave a bit of a sticky feeling but that's something I can look past.
reviews.zh: 皮膚吸收得很好，而且唔刺激。我好耐冇用過呢個品牌，差啲唔記得自己幾咁鍾意佢！用完的確會有少少黏笠感，但呢點我可以接受。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: The SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum is a skincare marvel. Its potent blend of Yuja extract and Vitamin C visibly brightens and diminishes dark spots. I'm delighted with how it leaves my skin glowing and even-toned. A must-have for anyone looking to tackle dark spots and achieve a radiant complexion. Highly recommended for luminous skin!
reviews.zh: SKINFOOD Yuja C 淡斑亮白精華係護膚界嘅瑰寶。佢結合咗柚子萃取同維他命C，有效提亮膚色並淡化色斑。用完之後皮膚光澤透亮、膚色均勻，真係好滿意。想對付色斑、追求透亮肌膚嘅人必入手，大力推薦畀想擁有光感肌嘅人！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text:
Very good serum, improved the condition of the skin, moisturises well, absorb quickly. 
Slightly sticky, smells nice.
reviews.zh:
精華非常好，改善咗膚質，保濕效果唔錯，吸收快。
略帶黏笠感，味道清香。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I didn’t use this yet since I just got it, but heard wonders about the product through my friends
reviews.zh: 啱啱到手所以未用過，但係聽朋友講過呢個產品好好用。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I have been using daily for a week and my skin is visibly brighter and looks plump and healthy. I have sensitive skin type an this serum is light weight and absorbs quickly.
reviews.zh: 我連續每日用咗一個星期，皮膚明顯提亮，望落飽滿又健康。我係敏感肌，而呢支精華質地輕盈，好快就吸收。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Yuja C Dark Spot Clear Serum 50mL
reviews.text: The product applies well and I used it for a week, but it feels like my skin tone got brighter and my skin got softer.
reviews.zh: 呢個產品上臉效果唔錯，我用咗一個星期，感覺膚色提亮咗，皮膚亦都變得柔軟咗。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
